newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGC wins Aramco gas plant expansion contract.
newsitem.headline: JGC wins Aramco gas plant expansion contract.

text.p: Engineering firm JGC Corp said on Thursday it had won a contract from Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco to expand a gas plant in Berri on the Gulf coast.
The project, scheduled for completion by February 2000, involves construction of desulphurising and sulphur recovery units at the plant, a JGC spokesman said.

He declined to comment on the capacity of the plant and the value of the contract, but Japanese newspaper reports said that the processing capacity will be raised by 250 million cubic feet per day to one billion cubic feet, and that the contract is estimated to be worth about 14 billion yen.
JGC Corp is responsible for engineering and procurement, while construction will be carried out by its local subsidiary JGC Arabia Ltd, the spokesman said.
